बर्थडे पर शाहरुख खान पर लुटाया प्यार तो भाईजान को मिला ऐसा धांसू जवाब! 🔥

बॉलीवुड के बादशाह शाहरुख खान ने 2 नवंबर को अपना 61वां जन्मदिन मनाया।

सलमान खान ने इंस्टाग्राम पर King फिल्म का गाना Tu Mil Jaaye शेयर कर लिखा कि हमेशा जवान रहो King, यही मेरी दुआ है।

इस पर शाहरुख खान ने उनकी Instagram Story को रीशेयर करते हुए लिखा कि आपने कहा था बिना शर्ट के अच्छी बॉडी है, सिर्फ इसी, लिए मेहनत की।

फिल्म King में शाहरुख खान की गजब की फिटनेस देख फैंस और सेलेब्स भी हैरान हैं, Karan Johar ने भी सोशल मीडिया पर जमकर तारीफ की।

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, शाहरुख ने मुंबई के एक होटल में परिवार और खास दोस्तों के साथ बर्थडे सेलिब्रेट किया जिसमें सलमान खान भी शामिल बताए जा रहे हैं।

बता दें कि Siddharth Anand के निर्देशन में बन रही यह फिल्म 24 दिसंबर 2026 को थिएटर्स में रिलीज होगी।

ctx.title: Salman Khan wishes Shah Rukh Khan stays young forever on his birthday; SRK says ‘working hard on physique because of you’
ctx.summary: Shah Rukh Khan revealed Salman Khan's motivation was the reason behind his chiselled physique in his upcoming movie King.
ctx.text:
Bollywood actor Shah Rukh Khan celebrated his 61st birthday on November 2. Several celebrities took to social media to pen heartfelt birthday wishes for him. Salman Khan 's birthday wish arrived late at night, and Shah Rukh made sure to send some love back.
Salman took to Instagram and shared Shah Rukh's song Tu Mil Jaaye from King. He wrote, "Happy Birthday Shahrukh hamesha jawaan raho The King, yeh meri dua hai (Stay young always, that's my prayer to God) @iamsrk."
Shah Rukh reshared Salman's Instagram Story and wrote, "Aapne kaha Bina shirt ke acchhi body hai sirf isse liye mehnat ki. Love u bhai always (You said that you have a good physique without a shirt, so I worked hard just for this. Love you, brother, always)."
Shah Rukh's physique in King has impressed fans and celebrities alike. Karan Johar couldn't stop gushing about it on social media, while fans also hailed the actor for his abs and chiselled physique as he went shirtless in the song Tu Mil Jaaye.
Kajol also shared a picture with Shah Rukh on Instagram and penned a heartfelt birthday wish for him. Her message read, "Happy Birthday @iamsrk! Stay the absolute rockstar that you are. Sending you the biggest hug today!"
As usual, Shah Rukh's fans gathered outside Mannat in the hope of catching a glimpse of the superstar on his special day. Many arrived with posters, cheered for the actor and recreated his iconic arms-wide-open pose while waiting to see him. The actor didn't disappoint them. He stepped out onto the balcony of his Mumbai home to greet the sea of fans waiting for him. Dressed casually, he struck his trademark arms-wide-open pose, drawing loud cheers from the crowd.
The actor reportedly celebrated his 61st birthday at a Mumbai hotel with his family and close friends. Salman Khan was also said to have attended the celebration.
Helmed by Siddharth Anand, the film stars Shah Rukh Khan in the lead role alongside Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan and Suhana Khan. Abhay Verma, Akshay Oberoi, Arshad Warsi, Raghav Juyal, Jaideep Ahlawat, Rani Mukerji and Saurabh Shukla, among others, feature in supporting roles.
The film is said to be an action romantic drama. It marks Shah Rukh's return to the big screen after a three-year gap and his daughter Suhana's theatrical debut, following her acting debut in The Archies. The film is scheduled to release in theatres on December 24, 2026.
